The public series makes backlogs visible while the court system can shift suitable disputes into faster channels without pretending that every case is the same.
preconditions: A judiciary with reliable case-management data and authority to redesign procedure across court tiers
Registries, judges, mediators and tribunals that can route cases by complexity rather than use one queue for all disputes
A public accountability norm that treats unresolved caseload as an operational problem while protecting judicial independence
pattern.travelled: Court-clearance management travels when administrative data, triage and dispute resolution reduce stock without turning speed into the only definition of justice.

records.title: France's long-term unemployment decline
records.claim: France's national statistics office Insee reported that people unemployed for at least one year represented 23.3% of all unemployed people in 2024, while the long-term unemployment rate was 1.7% of the active population, down from 3.1% in 2015.

metric.name: Long-term unemployed as share of all unemployed

source.publisher: Insee, Evolution du chômage / Employment Survey 2024

records.limits: The figures describe labour-market duration, not the causes of unemployment, the quality of re-employment or whether training and employment services produced the decline. Insee's household-survey definitions and population scope matter, and a low long-term share can coexist with high short-term churn or discouraged workers outside the unemployment measure.

pattern.mechanism: France's employment system combines unemployment insurance, employment-service counselling and targeted training or hiring support, helping some jobseekers move through the labour market before unemployment becomes persistent. The falling long-term rate is an outcome to investigate, not proof that one programme caused it.
preconditions: A labour-force survey and employment-service records that distinguish duration consistently
Income support and active labour-market services that preserve contact with jobseekers while they search
Employers, training providers and regional intermediaries able to convert counselling into credible vacancies or skill transitions
pattern.travelled: Long-term-unemployment reductions travel when income support, matching and skills services are connected to real employer demand; a falling rate can otherwise reflect exits from the labour force rather than successful re-employment.

records.title: Federal funding gaps and the 2019 shutdown
records.claim: The Congressional Research Service records 20 federal funding-gap shutdowns with at least one full day between FY1977 and FY2019, including the 35-day partial shutdown from 21 December 2018 to 25 January 2019, the longest in the period it surveys.

secondMetric.name: Funding-gap shutdowns with at least one full day

source.publisher: Congressional Research Service, Past Government Shutdowns: Key Resources

records.limits: Shutdown duration and frequency are institutional consequences that can reflect constitutional rules, divided government and bargaining strategy, not a direct measure of public attitudes or latent polarisation. The CRS series ends in FY2019 for this historical resource, and a shutdown's operational cost varies with which agencies lose budget authority.

pattern.mechanism: The US appropriations process allows a lapse in budget authority to stop or furlough parts of the federal government, turning unresolved political conflict into an interruption of administration. Continuing resolutions and contingency plans soften the shock but do not remove the incentive or the coordination cost of brinkmanship.
preconditions: Separated institutions in which the executive and legislature can block or condition annual appropriations
A legal shutdown rule that makes funding lapses administratively real rather than automatically extending the prior budget
Political parties willing to use public-service disruption as leverage, plus contingency systems that limit but cannot eliminate the damage
pattern.travelled: Funding-gap reversals travel as a warning: constitutional checks need a credible continuity mechanism, or polarised bargaining can turn a disagreement into a measurable loss of state capacity.

records.title: Chave Móvel Digital and Portugal's digital identity layer
records.claim: Portugal's digital-government platform reported 4.4 million active Chave Móvel Digital credentials and 141 million authentications by 23 October 2025, with 490 entities using Autenticação.gov.

source.publisher: Portugal Digital / ARTE, Identidade Digital statistics

records.limits: These are administrative adoption and usage totals, not measures of service quality, inclusion, authentication success, fraud or trust. An active credential is not necessarily a unique active person, and the government platform reports the totals itself; the figures do not show whether citizens can complete the services they authenticate for.

pattern.mechanism: Portugal made one state-certified mobile credential usable for authentication and signatures across public services and participating private services, so each new service can reuse an existing identity rather than build a separate account system.
preconditions: A trusted civil-identity register and a legal basis for remote signatures
Interoperable authentication APIs and agencies willing to adopt one national gateway
Registration, recovery and offline support for people who cannot rely on a smartphone
pattern.travelled: A shared digital identity travels when legal recognition, cross-agency interoperability and assisted access travel with the credential; a login count alone can hide exclusion or weak service completion.

records.title: Portugal's CoLAB applied-research network
records.claim: Portugal's Agência Nacional de Inovação reported 41 recognized Collaborative Laboratories (CoLABs), and its 2024 innovation report recorded 639 highly qualified staff contracted by CoLABs, 32 percent of them PhDs.

secondMetric.name: Highly qualified staff contracted by CoLABs

source.publisher: Agência Nacional de Inovação, Relatório Nacional de Inovação 2024

records.limits: The network and staffing totals show institutional reach, not research quality, business adoption, additionality or durable jobs. CoLABs are separate private non-profit entities and report through the programme; the figures do not cover every university-industry link or establish that public recognition caused the reported staffing.

pattern.mechanism: Portugal gives mission-led applied-research organisations a formal recognition and monitoring route, then combines public base or competitive funding with industry-facing agendas so researchers have an institution whose job is to carry work across the university-business boundary.
preconditions: Universities and firms willing to share researchers, facilities and intellectual-property arrangements
A public agency able to recognize, monitor and renew organisations against research and transfer agendas
Stable mixed funding so an applied laboratory can pursue long projects without becoming a consultancy only
pattern.travelled: The CoLAB form travels when recognition is tied to an accountable applied mission and real employer or industry demand; a list of centres without shared incentives does not create technology transfer.

records.title: Programa Qualifica and Portugal's adult-learning network
records.claim: Portugal's ANQEP reported 1,025,569 cumulative Qualifica registrations by December 2023; 90 percent received a training or recognition, validation and certification referral, and 510,113 registrants obtained some certification.

source.publisher: ANQEP, Plano de Atividades 2024

records.limits: These are cumulative programme reach and certification totals, not an annual participation rate, completion quality, learning gain or employment and wage effect. The count can include partial certifications and administrative registrations, and it does not identify how many participants would have qualified without Qualifica; ANQEP reports the programme's own administrative data.

pattern.mechanism: A national network of Centros Qualifica gives adults a common entry point for counselling, recognition and validation of prior learning (RVCC), formal training and a portable qualification record, linking fragmented providers to a visible pathway.
preconditions: Local centres with counsellors and assessors able to validate work-based learning
A qualification framework and records that employers and schools can understand
Funding and referral links to training providers, employment services and employers
pattern.travelled: Adult-learning systems travel when advice, prior-learning recognition and funded courses form one route; registrations without follow-through can otherwise become a throughput statistic rather than capability.

records.title: Portugal Ventures, a public venture-capital bridge
records.claim: Portugal Ventures, the public venture-capital company in the Banco Português de Fomento group, reports €233.2 million invested in 256 new companies since 2012 and €283 million under management.

source.publisher: Portugal Ventures, institutional performance figures

records.limits: These are company-reported cumulative portfolio figures, not venture-capital investment as a share of GDP, additionality, exits, survival, jobs or a counterfactual. The homepage does not give a full reference-year methodology, and the totals can include private co-investment effects as well as Portugal Ventures' own capital.

pattern.mechanism: A state-backed investor supplies pre-seed, seed and Series A capital, often alongside private investors, using staged minority investments and portfolio support to bridge companies that are too early for ordinary bank finance.
preconditions: A pipeline of founders and research-derived firms large enough to fill investment rounds
Investment professionals with authority to make commercial decisions inside a public mandate
Follow-on private capital and exit markets so public money can recycle rather than become permanent subsidy
pattern.travelled: Public venture capital travels when it crowds in follow-on investors and accepts portfolio risk transparently; a state fund that only replaces missing private money can preserve firms without building a market.

records.title: Novas Oportunidades, and the qualification-policy interruption
records.claim: ANQEP's national review records 1,568,490 adult enrolments in Novas Oportunidades between 2006 and July 2011; after the initiative's peak and a period of disinvestment, Portugal launched Qualifica in 2017 and rebuilt a network of more than 300 Centros Qualifica.

secondMetric.name: Centros Qualifica in the replacement network

source.publisher: ANQEP, Plano Nacional de Literacia de Adultos

records.limits: Enrolment is a reach measure, not completed learning, quality, labour-market effect or value for money. The review's 1.57 million figure covers a high-activity period, while the later 300-plus-centre figure describes the replacement network rather than retained Novas Oportunidades capacity; the record evidences interruption and rebuilding, not a causal estimate of the policy's return.

pattern.mechanism: Novas Oportunidades scaled adult qualification through recognition and validation of prior learning (RVCC), adult education and training (EFA) routes and a national delivery network; when political and fiscal support receded, the infrastructure contracted and a successor programme had to rebuild entry points.
preconditions: A national qualification framework that can turn work experience into recognized credits
Local centres, assessors and training providers able to process large cohorts
Long-horizon funding and cross-party continuity, because adult-learning capacity is slow to rebuild after a stop
pattern.travelled: The interruption travels as a warning: mass adult-learning systems need continuity and credible standards, or a high-enrolment push can leave a capability gap when the delivery network is withdrawn.
